name: woocommerce/order-refund-create
label: Refund order
description: Refund an amount or lines of an order. With refund_payment, the payment gateway sends the money back; without it, the refund is only recorded and the money is returned outside WooCommerce.

amount.description: Amount to refund, including tax, such as 12.50. Without line_items, it refunds this amount of the order. With line_items, it defaults to their total and cannot be lower.

line_items.description: Order lines to refund. Send quantity to refund whole units, or refund_total for a tax-inclusive amount of the line.

line_item_id.description: ID of the order line, from the woocommerce/orders-query ability with include_line_items and include_lines.

refund_total.description: Tax-inclusive amount to refund for the line. Negative only for a discount or credit line.

refund_payment.description: Whether the payment gateway sends the money back.

restock_items.description: Whether to return the refunded quantities of the product lines to stock.

allow_duplicate_of.description: ID of the refund that a duplicate error returned. Send it, with the same input, only when the merchant asked for a second refund after being told about that one. Never send it to retry a failed or timed-out call.

reason.description: Reason for the refund. Omitted when none was given.

refunded_by.description: ID of the user who made the refund. Omitted when nobody was logged in.

refunded_payment.description: Whether WooCommerce recorded that the payment gateway refunded the payment. False for a manual refund, but also when the gateway or an extension refunded it and the refund was not marked as paid, so check with the gateway when a refund error asked you to.

date_created.description: Refund date in the store timezone.

line_items.description: Order lines that the refund covers. Empty for a refund of an amount only.

total.description: Amount refunded for the line, excluding tax. Negative for a discount or credit line.
